mapping.title: Archive settings
mapping.subtitle: Bind the archive root and edit pointer classification. Path rules stay in Git / CONTRACT.md — this page does not invent a second rule table.
mapping.root_hint: Each daemon can bind one local directory as the archive root. Switching the bind changes the project pointer, not files on disk.
mapping.rules_readonly: Path rules are read-only — change CONTRACT.md, then sync or scan again.
mapping.index_hint: Create / edit / delete here changes the Multica index only. Git files are kept.
mapping.index_empty: Nothing indexed yet. Scan a folder or add a document to write a pointer.
mapping.remove_confirm: Remove “{{name}}” from the index? The git file is kept.
mapping.recognition_hint: Renders doc_classifier recognition JSON (coverage / sources / failure attribution). The server never runs the classifier.
mapping.recognition_empty: No report yet. Run the command at the projects_mgmt root, or paste the JSON.
mapping.recognition_taxonomy_hint: Only four shelves are stored. The 12 taxonomy types fold into those shelves — no fifth C2 card.
mapping.dir_changelogs: change_logs/<project_key>/{daily_logs, …} (scope: project, change-log / work-plan; not a stage gate)
mapping.stage_rule: The s<N>-slug/ path segment maps to stage N ∈ 1..4; out-of-range values are rejected at sync time.
mapping.er_artifact: project_artifact — git pointer (rel_path + blob_sha) + scope/stage/doc_type projection
mapping.er_graph: project_graph_snapshot — latest 5 graph snapshots; module_summary / bus_matrix pre-aggregated
mapping.er_ontology: ontology_object / ontology_link / ontology_changelog — 4E ontology layer (degraded until extraction lands)
mapping.er_filing: filing_item / filing_check_run / filing_export_log — three-tier contract: must / conditional / aux
mapping.er_runs: agent_run / agent_run_todo / agent_run_event — single-direction projection of the session stream
mapping.step_1: 1. CLI scans the archive directory (git ls-files + blob sha)
mapping.step_2: 2. Derives scope / stage / doc_type / version from the path contract
mapping.step_3: 3. Submits the full manifest (+ optional graph snapshot) in one POST
mapping.step_4: 4. Server diffs inside one transaction: upsert hits, soft-delete absentees
mapping.step_5: 5. Filing checklist recomputed; graph snapshots trimmed to the newest 5
mapping.auto_hint: Path contract + frontmatter + Desktop/CLI manifest derive scope / stage / doc_type / doc_class. path_first keeps the path; review_queue leaves dual-signal files unbound. Git is the source of truth; the server never reads disk.
mapping.manual_hint: Screen 3 binding, inbox adopt onto the four shelves, or create from a template. Rebinding writes frontmatter by default; pointer-only edits need a reason and stay source=manual.

sync.title: Sync & link
sync.subtitle: Work the pending-bind queue and bind the archive root. A full manifest can only be submitted by the CLI / Desktop after it reads the directory.
sync.unbound_hint: Requirement-scope documents not yet linked to a calendar issue. Binding writes multica_issue_id back to frontmatter by default and does not rename folders.
sync.bind_unavailable: Manual binding is not available yet — bind via the CLI manifest (issue_id) or the archive action.
sync.no_requirements: This project has no calendar requirements yet, so nothing can be bound.
sync.candidate_hint: Heuristic match on path / REQ-KEY / issue identifier. Confirm before binding.
sync.candidate_empty: Not enough signal to recommend a match.
sync.log_empty: Sync runs are not streamed — the server keeps no batch status. Check the CLI output for the diff counts.
sync.pipeline_hint: Stage states are inferred from the last sync result — per-stage reporting needs CLI support (no sync_diagnostics table yet).
sync.scope_locked: Read-only — making the scope configurable requires CLI-side coordination; not open yet.
sync.scope_assets: Assets — index only, no snapshot upload
sync.source_none: No archive resource bound to this project.
sync.bind_need_resource: Add a local directory resource first, then bind it as the archive root.
sync.source_path_unknown: Path unknown — the bound resource is not a local directory.
sync.daemon_unavailable: Not detectable in the browser — desktop shell only.
sync.revalidate_hint: The browser submits no manifest: the full manifest can only come from the CLI / local daemon that reads the archive directory. This button re-reads the server state and checks the sync path — it never writes artifact rows.
sync.revalidate_noop: No manifest submitted, nothing changed — server archive state re-read.
sync.empty_local: No contract documents found in the local folder; no manifest submitted.
sync.desktop_need_root: Bind projects_mgmt/projects/<key> before syncing the local archive.
sync.diag_hint: Parse warnings from the last archive sync. Historical paths can be recognized without counting as filed.
sync.diag_empty: No unclassified diagnostics. Run archive sync on this machine first.
sync.inbox_empty: Local _shared/inbox is empty, or the browser cannot read disk.
sync.inbox_hint: Unclassified drafts. Adopt onto one of the four shelves under overview/, then Desktop-sync. Move or git-commit the inbox original yourself.
sync.inbox_adopt_failed: Could not write the inbox file onto a shelf
sync.policy_hint: Same semantics as the CLI. No git hook or scheduled sync; sync_mode stays manual.
sync.policy_path_first_hint: Frontmatter issue_id is submitted with the manifest; the path REQ-KEY is kept.
sync.policy_review_queue_hint: When the path has a REQ-KEY and frontmatter has an issue_id, do not auto-bind.
sync.policy_save_failed: Could not save the conflict policy
sync.writeback_default: Also write Git frontmatter on bind (handbook §5)
sync.scaffold_ok_disk: Requirement archive {{key}} created and written locally
sync.scaffold_failed: Issue created, but the requirement folder was not written

browser.search_placeholder: Search path, filename, or type (e.g. change-log)…
browser.empty: No artifacts match the current filters
browser.empty_never_synced_hint: Run the archive sync from the CLI to publish the manifest.
browser.select_hint: Select a document to see its metadata and preview.
browser.tag_clear: Clear to fall back to the parent folder
browser.tag_batch_hint: Select documents, then apply one tag
browser.drag_hint: Drag to another shelf to refile. Drag empty space to lasso; Shift / ⌘-click to add.
browser.move_exists: {{n}} already exist at the target path
browser.move_need_pick: Select or lasso the documents first
browser.move_same_shelf: These documents are already on that shelf

browser.tag_not_persisted: The tag was not saved on the server. Restart the API and try again.

preview.title: Document preview
preview.content_unavailable: Preview content is unavailable — the archive stores only the git pointer. On desktop, the bound archive root can supply the body.
preview.content_unavailable_search: The file was not found under the bound local directory. Archive bodies live in the projects_mgmt contract tree, not the code repo. Pick the project archive folder that contains overview/.
preview.content_unavailable_restart: The desktop file-read bridge is unavailable. Quit and restart the desktop app, then preview again.
preview.web_no_disk: The browser cannot silently read disk. Pick the archive root folder to preview index-only documents.

archive_action.title: Archive deliverable
archive_action.success: Archived — the classification is recorded with source "agent"
archive_action.cli_hint: The CLI writes the file into the archive directory on the next sync; this action records the server-side classification.
